verdict.rationale: Drata is a SaaS compliance platform that processes customer data and offers AI features such as AI-agent interaction and questionnaire automation, so an AI-training opt-out or data-use guarantee is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions any policy, setting or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The items on the API, the MCP server and the device agent's read-only permissions are about other capabilities and earn no credit here.
